scope.excluded: non-.js files under examples/jsm listed in summary.non_js_files; assets, CSS and nested HTML out of scope

extractor.parser: TypeScript compiler API full AST; cross-checked with es-module-lexer, 0 discrepancies
extractor.line_counting: physical_lines = LF count + 1 for a final unterminated line
extractor.imports: static import/export-from specifiers verbatim (relative, bare, URL); all 278 re-exports belong to the excluded Addons.js aggregate, so no per-entry flag is stored
extractor.dynamic_imports: literal, identifier-bound const string (specifier + resolved_from) or raw expression; non-resolvable expressions have no specifier
extractor.omitted: parser diagnostics (all 500 modules and 617 pages parsed cleanly), lexer cross-check counters, duplicated aggregate listings, threejs.org self/screenshot page links
